entries.zh: 才疏学浅、本领差；所知甚少
entries.en: to know little; to have meagre talent
entries.notes: M 栏圈内第三项（munogf…sabe）残损且含 T99 不可辨，释义据仍清晰的「劣才/loar chay」与 L「Saber poco」核心互证。

entries.zh: 略知一二、稍谙其事；所知甚浅
entries.en: to know little; to be slightly versed in a thing
entries.notes: M 音写 am 与 H「語」音不合（语白读 gi/gú），疑原字为「諳」（am），释义从 L「Saber poco」。

entries.en: to know a little; to have slight acquaintance
to know where (one is going) and the roads there are

entries.zh: 见识广博、阅历多；无所不晓
entries.en: to know much, to have knowledge of it all; wide insight and experience
entries.notes: M 栏前段残损（guin [残]），后段 guin fit 音节归属不明，释义主据 H「見識」与 L。

entries.en: to know how to work and toil
entries.notes: H「曲節」确指未详（或近「屈节」屈身劳作之义），zh 义从 L「Saber trabajar」及本页 saber 系列语境推断。

entries.zh: 知尊卑、懂得各按名分敬人
entries.en: to know how to honor each one as he deserves; to know rank and precedence

entries.zh: 半知、一知半解；略知一二
entries.en: to know something of it; half-knowledge
ability, competence; to know how to manage business

entries.zh: 会经营事务；絲綸本义丝缕，引申经纬治理
entries.en: to know how to negotiate and conduct affairs; lit. silk thread(s), classically imperial edict
entries.notes: 「絲綸」字面丝缕、古指王言诏令，与 saber negociar 的对应取经纬事务引申，语义衔接依赖推断。

entries.en: to know how to conduct oneself in affairs; statecraft, skill in ordering matters

entries.zh: 运转、施展；会做事、能活动
entries.en: to know how to do something; lit. to move, to exert
entries.notes: L 行间插注尾词残缺（Tiene fu[残]）；「运动」取运转施展义以合 L「saber hacer algo」。

entries.zh: 手段、办事的方法与本领
entries.en: means and skill, resourcefulness; to know one's trade/office well
entries.notes: L 缩写 off° 按 officio 展开属推断，且 M 第二音节污损（T99）。

entries.en: livelihood; to know how to earn one's living
to know what lies in one's heart; to know the inside of a matter

entries.zh: 不如伊（他）、比不上；所知较少
entries.en: to know less of it; inferior to him/it
to be exposed, to come to light (of wrongdoing)
entries.notes: L 行字迹潦草（fere、consejo 难确读，约含告诫之意），释义主据 H/M「敗露」。

entries.zh: 真知的见、看得真切分明（近「真知灼见」）
entries.en: to see and know it clearly; true and penetrating insight
entries.notes: L 原写 yucrlo clara mente 潦草，按 saber verlo claramente（看得清楚）解读。

entries.en: to know everything, as God does; omniscient
deeply learned, erudite
cultivation, inward nurture; depth of learning
entries.notes: 「涵养」与 doctissimo 的对应取涵蓄学养之义，衔接略凭推断。

entries.en: great talent, very learned
